summary_en: 500M share buyback authorization, ¥1.0T upper limit, 4.22% of shares outstanding, open-market execution window Aug 5, 2026–Aug 4, 2027. Cancellation of 200M shares (1.37% of pre-cancellation issued shares) scheduled for quarter-end following completion of acquisition.
title_en: Notice of determination of matters regarding treasury share acquisition and notice of treasury share cancellation
translation_en_brief: Toyota Motor Corporation's board of directors resolved on 4 August 2026 to authorize the acquisition of up to 500 million shares of its own common stock (4.22% of shares outstanding, excluding treasury) with an upper limit expenditure of ¥1.0 trillion via open-market purchases during the period from 5 August 2026 through 4 August 2027. The board also resolved to cancel 200 million shares (1.37% of issued shares before cancellation) on the final day of the quarter in which the acquisition is completed. The stated rationale is to implement opportunistic treasury acquisitions and improve capital efficiency in light of equity-market valuations and prevailing share price levels. As of 30 June 2026, Toyota held 2.753 billion shares in treasury (excluding ESOP trust holdings) out of 11.842 billion issued shares.
